next_unblocked_work: Extend the exact-page selector to accept only safe exact Downloads identifiers observed in official MBS link forms (without accepting URLs, paths, queries, fragments, or encoded separators); then publish eligible monthly_schedule_xml pages in cohorts of at most 24 under the existing protected hosted workflow, reconciling exact receipts and identity conflicts.
denominator_boundary: The current Downloads index lists 55 page URLs and 531 downloadable resource links, including 82 distinct MBS-XML links across 41 pages. Ten of those 82 links match current public B1 receipt source URLs at revision 52ad5c31cfe101c487a4c7a9c382540642e6110a; 72 have no matching receipt in this pinned archive head. The separate Previous Downloads page lists 106 direct file links spanning 1974–2010, 105 PDF and one XML. This is an index-level, format-separated starting inventory, not a complete expected MBS/PBS period denominator or M-107 acceptance.
